images.alt: A cartoon farmer is inviting someone to walk on a path across his land. In the background are mountains, trees and sheep. The text on the image reads "walk this way".  The background to the image is partially drawn with AI.

post.text: If you’ve got a special corner of NZ that you want to share, we can help you set up a public walkway. Here are some of the benefits of creating legal access on your land: www.herengaanuku.govt.nz/advice/landh...

source.agency_name: Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa (Outdoor Access Commission)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
